title: Auto Loans: Bank-Error Waiver of Returned Payment Fees
content:
Piedmont Crescent Bank corrects, as its own error, certain returned payment fees charged on Auto Loans accounts. This page describes when that correction is owed, why, and the action that books it.

## When the waiver is owed

A returned payment fee has been charged contrary to the Auto Loans rules where the payment whose return gave rise to it was an autopay debit that PCB drew against one of the borrower's PCB checking accounts, and that account's closing date in the borrower's checking records comes earlier than the day the debit posted. Such a fee is waived in full as a bank error, through a single fee waiver entry that names the fee. The correction is owed whenever the loan's records show these circumstances; it does not depend on the borrower asking for it.

## Why it is the bank's error

An autopay arrangement at PCB is valid only against a paying account that is open on the date of each debit. The requirement that the paying account be an active checking account held by the borrower is tested when autopay is set up and continues to govern every debit made afterwards. A debit sent to an account that PCB's own records already list as closed is a failure on PCB's side, not one the borrower caused.

## Effect of the waiver

A fee waiver entry is booked on the loan's activity for the named returned payment fee, carrying bank error as the waiver reason and returned payment as the fee code. The loan's unpaid fees fall by the waived sum less any part applied to principal, and its unpaid principal falls by that applied part, which is used only when the fee had already been paid.

## Invoking the action

This correction is booked with `waive_returned_payment_fee_ab31cb83`, which the agent first unlocks and then calls on its own side.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the borrower's customer reference number, from the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `auto_loan_id` | the loan on which the fee was charged, from the auto loan lookup | identifier |
| `source_item_id` | the returned payment fee entry that is being waived, as it appears in the auto loan activity lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | the sum waived, which equals the whole fee | USD to two decimals |
| `applied_to_principal` | the part of the waived sum credited to principal because the fee had already been paid | USD to two decimals; 0.00 when the fee was still unpaid |

## Receipt

A successful waiver returns status "waived" with `waiver_id` (the new waiver entry), `waived_fee_id` (the fee waived), `amount`, and the loan's `fees_due` and `principal_balance` afterwards, each to two decimals.
